senses.gloss:
Aupoditi, ‘descendant of Upodita,’ is the patronymic applied in the taittirīya Saṃhitā to Tumiñja, and in the baudhāyana śrauta sūtra to gaupālāyana, son of Vyāghrapad, sthapati (‘general’) of the Kurus. In the form of Aupoditeya, a metronymic from Upoditā, the name is found in the Śatapatha brāhmaṇa, where the kāṇva text calls him Tumiñja Aupoditeya vaiyāghrapadya.
